name: heat_curve
description: Curve to control how supply line temp is affected by out door temp. High value increase indoor temp and low value descrease indoor temp

name: heat_curve_min_temp
description: Lowest used supply line temp from heat pump [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_curve_max_temp
description: Highest used supply line temp from heat pump [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_curve_adjust_temp_plus_5_degree
description: Adjustment of heat curve at 5 degree outdoor temp [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_curve_adjust_temp_0_degree
description: Adjustment of heat curve at 0 degree outdoor temp [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_curve_adjust_temp_minus_5_degree
description: Adjustment of heat curve at -5 degree outdoor temp [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_stop_outdoor_temp_limit

name: heat_setback_temp
description: Indoor setback temperature [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_room_temp_factor
description: Applied offset to supply line temp to get 1 degree change of room temp [Kelvin] as integer

name: room_temp_desired
description: Desired indoor room temp set in heat pump [Celsius] as integer

name: heat_curve2_max_temp

name: heat_curve2_adjust_temp_0_degree

name: heat_curve2_adjust_temp_minus_5_degree

name: heat_curve3_adjust_temp_minus_5_degree

name: distribution_circuit_2_constant_temp

name: pool_temp_stop_limit
description: Upper limit when production of pool heating is stopped [Celsius] as integer

name: tapwater_temp_start_limit
description: Lower limit when production of hot tapwater is triggered [Celsius] as integer

name: tapwater_max_time
description: Max time for continues production of hot tapwater when other demands also exist [Minutes] as integer

name: tapwater_temp_stop_limit
description: Upper limit when production of hot tapwater is stopped [Celsius] as integer
